transcript.line: Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — every fire has a theory tonight.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Pavel is calling it "Big Ugly." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.
Fatima showed Rafael the Elderberry — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
👥 Valentina heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
👥 Luis walks out with Valentina. "Nobody walks alone today."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
